part.text:
- **Stop outdoor observations** when the wind interlock opens. Preserve reservation identifiers during the suspension. [weather.md, lines 3–7](/tmp/opencode/step12-live-work/project/weather.md#L3-L7)
- **Restart only after** the wind interlock closes **and** the duty operator records a restart approval. A favourable forecast cannot authorize a restart. [weather.md, lines 7, 13–15](/tmp/opencode/step12-live-work/project/weather.md#L7-L15)
- **An indoor instrument may continue** if it is explicitly classified as indoor and its own safety interlocks remain closed. A roof shown as closed on the calendar does not establish that classification. [weather.md, lines 9–11](/tmp/opencode/step12-live-work/project/weather.md#L9-L11)
